Subject: Temporary rate floor & launch traffic signal — coordinated asks

Team,

We have BrightLane (Sana) asking for a short-term uplift window and a guaranteed minimum throughput for their global launch next Wednesday. Quick summary of asks from discovery:
- 48–72 hour elevated ingress window starting 2027-06-16 with a recommended rate floor of 2.5x their current committed rate (they expect aggressive churn of clients into the new feature).
- A telemetry signal we can expose so their platform can route away if we return 429s; they also want a warmup ramp schedule.

Product asks / questions for infra & ops:
1) Can we implement a temporary rate floor (bypass soft-throttle) scoped to their API key / org for up to 72 hours, and roll it back automatically?
2) What guardrails do we need on batching/kv cache to avoid latency spike when traffic hits the higher tail?
3) What metrics will infra need from sales/product to author the policy (expected RPS distribution, median seq length, peak concurrency)?

Attached a traffic forecast that BrightLane shared (brightlane_launch_traffic_model_v2.xlsx) and a draft temporary rate-floor proposal (temporary_rate_floor_proposal.pdf).

I propose we:
- Approve a temporary rate-floor with an automatic 72hr expiration and a 4-tier downgrade schedule if error-rate crosses thresholds.
- Instrument a single boolean signal 'rlb:brightlane-warmup' in the webhook for their routing team and provide a webhook URL for 429+ degradation notifications.

Please reply with feasibility and concrete inputs by EOD tomorrow. If infra needs a sync call I can carve 30 minutes on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
